# Kela Link Ltd

> Property management, travel and daily errand services in Kenya for Kenyans living abroad.

Kela Link Ltd (Kela Assistance Services) supports the Kenyan diaspora by handling on-the-ground services in Kenya: property management, construction supervision, travel planning, daily errands and custom-tailored assistance. Serving clients across the US, Canada, UK, UAE, Australia, Norway and Germany.
